description: Patients for whom one lab test shows both a negative urine protein result and a negative rheumatoid factor result.

d.request: Find patients having at least one single Laboratory record where `U-PRO` = '-' and `RA` = '-' simultaneously, join to Patient for sex, and for each such patient and sex compute the average `ALP` and average `HCT` across all of that patient's Laboratory records (not only the qualifying record, ignoring NULLs, unrounded), ordered by average `HCT` descending with NULL averages last, limited to 10 rows.
d.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL), avg_HCT DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For patients who have a single lab record (the same Laboratory row) where `U-PRO` is '-' and `RA` is '-', list each patient's ID and sex (Patient table only), plus the average `ALP` and average `HCT` computed across all of that patient's lab records (ignoring NULLs, unrounded), grouped by ID and sex, ordered by average `HCT` descending with NULL averages last, top 10.
b.sql: SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALP) AS avg_alp, AVG(L.HCT) AS avg_hct FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(L.HCT) IS NULL), AVG(L.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

Group by patient ID and sex, sort by average `HCT` from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
a.sql: SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(L.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(L.HCT) IS NULL), AVG(L.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10
